title: Zombie wearable "Office blazer" (upper) - fitted per body (prototype)

status.stage: unapproved prototype derivative (iteration 06 zombie wardrobe); art/anatomy/deformation/fit not certified
status.licenseClearance: none - evaluation quality does not grant commercial rights; sources are AI reconstructions of AI-generated concept images

honesty.rig: NEW derivative skeleton (shared 18-joint naming/hierarchy) and automatic skin weights created by this CPU pipeline
honesty.animation: hand-authored procedural keyframes (same clip functions for every body, sampled with each body's own joint positions) - NOT motion capture
honesty.generation: no AI generation, inference, model download or network service was used by this builder
honesty.garment: garment source is a separate ghost-mannequin reconstruction; fitted and skinned per body by this pipeline (no cloth simulation)

t25.note: source master unchanged (legacy local Pixal3D); file rebuilt because its per-body fits / masks follow bodies replaced in this migration

glb.format: glTF 2.0 binary; shared material/texture + shared TEXCOORD_0/index accessors; one SkinnedMesh per body (own POSITION/NORMAL/JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 + skin over that body's joints); scene extras zombieWearable

global.method: aspect-preserving scale from width = 1.12 x body chest + 0.02 m; armpit -> body armpit - 0.035 m; depth = body + 0.05 m (clamped 0.65-1.05 of vertical)

final.method: closest-point transfer from body weights (barycentric), Head->Neck, centre-faded skirt rule below crotch, masked smoothing; region mask: arm weights on torso panels fade out 3-15 cm below the armpit, sleeves keep their own arm chain + Chest

simplify.errorMetric: position quadric (normal attribute weight 0: fewest folds/slivers in comparison)

bake.method: closest facing-compatible point, overridden by first front-facing hit of a cage ray (P+N*cage -> -N) when within 1.2 cm of it

lastshift.collisionTarget: whole body + fitted lower garments above the crotch (layering)

transfer.method: closest-point transfer from body weights (barycentric), Head->Neck, centre-faded skirt rule below crotch, masked smoothing; region mask: arm weights on torso panels fade out 3-15 cm below the armpit, sleeves keep their own arm chain + Chest

refit07.method: region-restricted outer-hull anchors -> body weights at the anchor -> bind clearance (anchor + body/lower vertex driven) -> pose-validated extra clearance -> all-pose masks (lib/fit07.mjs)

mask.method: normal + 4 rays tilted 28 deg from 0.03 m below each body triangle centroid; hidden when all hit the fitted garment within 0.09 m of the surface; head/hands/feet/legs (and arms under sleeveless garments) never hidden; AND every outer-hull vertex covered (no poke-through, never exposed) in all 89 validation poses (lib/fit07.mjs)

limitations: No cloth simulation: linear-blend skinned with weights transferred from each body; it cannot drape, swing or collide in motion.
Per-body fit = skeleton-driven retarget + bind-pose push-out (+ collision with the body's fitted pants above the crotch); residual interpenetration appears in strong poses.
Body triangles fully enclosed by the item in the bind pose are hidden per body; in motion small gaps can reveal the underlying body or base clothing.
Hidden-side geometry of the source is AI-hallucinated.
